entries:
Patch 0.22.15 (Starter loot and forge guidance now explains what is worth keeping)

  • Starter loot truth: Inventory, start-flow, and town guidance now explain that obvious Common gear is usually vendor cleanup while better drops are worth checking before selling.
  • Forge-material clarity: Shards, Hearts, and Gems are now called out more explicitly as forge materials worth saving instead of accidental vendor trash.
  • Better service handoff: Merchant, Stash, Forge, and Trading House guidance now do a cleaner job of telling you what belongs where during the first hour.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for starter inventory guidance, starter recovery guidance, and 0.22.15 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.14 (Pre-fight boss objectives now tell you to commit)

  • Boss-commit truth: Pre-fight boss objectives now use commit language instead of flat discovered-room placeholder copy.
  • Guidance sync: Boss guidance now tells you to reset and commit before the fight is live, matching the callout layer.
  • Boss-state separation: Boss journal entries now distinguish commit-before-engage from Boss Now execution guidance.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for pre-live boss objective guidance and 0.22.14 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.13 (Cleared dungeons now read like extraction, not a fake turn-in)

  • Extraction-state truth: Cleared dungeons now shift the objective panel into extraction language instead of a generic completed turn-in state.
  • Exit objective clarity: Exit objectives now tell you to backtrack out with the loot after the boss is down.
  • Journal guidance fix: Cleared dungeon guidance no longer falls back to Turn this in for 0 XP in the journal panel.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for cleared-dungeon extraction guidance and 0.22.13 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.12 (Transitional route beats now read like real approach states)

  • Approach-state truth: Dungeon objective fallback guidance now describes transitional approach beats instead of generic push deeper copy.
  • Boss bridge clarity: One-room bridge states now call out the last approach room before the boss instead of vague final-room phrasing.
  • Shrine-route clarity: Longer neutral stretches now point cleanly toward the shrine reset, so approach rooms read like authored pacing instead of filler.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for transitional objective summaries, journal guidance rendering, and 0.22.12 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.11 (Ambush objectives now keep their pressure-spike language)

  • Ambush objective truth: Dungeon objective guidance now gives ambush rooms the same pressure-spike language already used by live callouts.
  • Journal sync: Ambush objectives and journal guidance now say Elite room ahead — pressure spike incoming instead of drifting back to generic elite-discovered copy.
  • Route continuity: Ambush route previews still show the next beats after the spike, so the journal keeps telling the same dungeon story as the minimap, world map, and callout layer.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for ambush objective summaries, journal guidance rendering, and 0.22.11 version presentation.

Patch 0.22.10 (Dungeon entrance hints stay truthful while you move)

  • Moving-play clarity: Dungeon entrance hints now stay truthful to the live beat while you are moving instead of falling back to generic open-portal copy.
  • Beat-aware portal guidance: Hovered dungeon portals now preview chest, ambush, shrine, and boss urgency using the same authored pacing language as route callouts.
  • Live refresh: Entrance hints now refresh immediately when dungeon room-state progression changes under the cursor, so portal guidance does not lag one beat behind the run.
  • Regression coverage: Added tests around beat-aware entrance hint copy, live boss entrance urgency, room-state-triggered hint refresh, and 0.22.10 version / patch-note presentation.

Patch 0.22.9 (Dungeon route guidance now sharpens around the next spike)

  • Treasure room truth: Chest objectives now warn when the reward room is just a quick score before the ambush spike instead of staying on generic loot copy.
  • Shrine timing clarity: Shrine objectives now call out the last reset before the boss push when the next meaningful beat is the boss room.
  • Journal guidance sync: Objective-panel guidance now mirrors the same authored pacing language the combat callouts already use, so route text and in-run warnings stop drifting apart.
  • Regression coverage: Added tests around sharpened chest and shrine objective copy, guidance rendering, and 0.22.9 version / patch-note presentation.

Patch 0.22.8 (Live boss state stays truthful across dungeon route surfaces)

  • Boss state truth: Dungeon route surfaces now stay truthful during live boss fights instead of leaving some UI on "boss ahead" while the encounter is already active.
  • Map sync: Minimap, world map, and objective tracker now all promote the active boss state to Boss Now when you are already in the boss room.
  • Journal execution guidance: The boss objective flips from planning copy into survive the boss fight execution guidance once the fight is live, and stale route-preview text drops away.
  • Regression coverage: Added tests around live boss markers on map surfaces, live boss objective guidance, and 0.22.8 version / patch-note presentation.

Patch 0.22.7 (Economy onboarding tells you what to sell where)

  • Starter economy guidance: The new-player flow now tells you to dump junk at Vendor / Repair instead of leaving early inventory cleanup implied.
  • Market handoff: First-session guidance now tells you to save market-worthy drops for the Trading House once you start finding gear worth listing.
  • Town objective clarity: Starter town objectives now reinforce Stash, Vendor / Repair, and Trading House together so the economy loop is readable before leaving town.
  • Regression coverage: Added tests around start-flow copy, town-objective economy guidance, and 0.22.7 version / patch-note presentation.

Patch 0.22.6 (Trading House and Vendor guidance split)

  • Separate market stop: Trading House now shows up separately for player-to-player buying and selling instead of being folded into Vendor / Repair.
  • True town anchors: Trading House now points at the real market building while Vendor / Repair stays pinned to the actual merchant NPC.
  • Clear service prompts: Trading House now tells you to buy and sell items with other players, while Vendor / Repair now stays focused on gambling and unloading unwanted gear.
  • Regression coverage: Added tests around split service labels, exact anchors, hover hint copy, and 0.22.6 version / patch-note presentation.
